steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: After that, it should be Robin's...

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Before we get there, Ms. Mayer.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: There's something else I want to ask you.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: What's up? I don't know nearly as much as Silence.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Not a problem. This is something you know just as well as she does.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: What do you think of the whole 'Diαbolic Crisis?'

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If I'm not mistaken, you were part of that project, weren't you?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Eh, don't have a clue.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: We Engineering folks usually just hand out the equipment, maybe give some professional advice when the equipment gets made. We don't usually try to figure out what the experiment is all about.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: I just know how it turned out in the end. Silence brought Ifrit with her to Rhodes Island, a place she barely had a working relationship with.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: After that, Saria ended up taking responsibility for everything that happened and left Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: If you're trying to learn about what went down there, you're asking the wrong girl.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: No, it's not the incident itself that I wanted to know more about. I mean, incidents like that one are a dime a dozen at Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hm, so why are you asking?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm asking because I want to know, from your perspective, what kind of a person do you think Silence is? And how about Saria?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hm, I think Silence's a pretty serious girl. Honestly, I've always felt that's the way all researchers should be.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You're right. She's very smart. She's very perceptive, too. Plus, she's had more than a few successful projects under her belt.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: From what I heard, the Structural Director's hoping to prime Silence to take over.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Wow, you mean Silence's gonna be calling the shots at Structural? That's so cool!

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Yeah, even I wanna butter her up now~

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: As for Saria, I don't actually know her that well.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: I mean, Defense isn't like the other departments. I hardly ever saw her in Rhodes Island, let alone talked to her.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: But the biggest impression I have of her is she's really cautious, going from what I know about the 'Diαbolic Crisis.'

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: I mean, she was the one who hit the brakes on the whole project. She even took the blame for everything and quit, even though experiments going wrong isn't actually that uncommon there.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: There were rumors among my coworkers that the 'Diαbolic Crisis' was some kinda conspiracy. I don't know that much about that stuff, though.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Besides, Ifrit's having a great time at Rhodes Island all around, so I guess it wasn't a big deal.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hm? So the test subject is doing well at Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Yep, like she's always on top of the whole world.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Oh, and here I thought... Well, gotta hand it to them, then. Rhodes Island sounds like a pretty impressive company.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But well, there's one thing I can tell you. Saria didn't leave Rhine Lab just because of the 'Diαbolic Crisis.' It's just one of a whole string of events that led to it, and there's more to it.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: It might have been the straw that broke the burdenbeast's back, though.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: The primary reason was that she had a beef with Control.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Huh? Control?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's right. Saria and Control actually got along okay at first, you know?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But, like you said, Saria was way too cautious. She thinks all scientific research should be contained.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's not how Control saw it, though. There would've been no Rhine Lab if she did.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: How should I say this? Let's try an analogy.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Let's say we have a line. Saria's line.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Rhine Lab's always done things above board. They've come close to crossing the line, but they've never actually done it, so Saria never said anything.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But that whole string of events, the 'Diαbolic Crisis' included, meant that someone was trying to cross that line. They might even have crossed it already.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Saria wouldn't have that.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But Control didn't care.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Why's that?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Ms. Mayer, tell me. Do you actually care about the whole thing with Anthony that Ms. Silence and I were talking about at all?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hm... Well, now that I know more about what happened to him, I guess it's not a bad thing that he got out. Something like that, I guess?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You see? You're honest and kind, but you couldn't care less. You care more about your research, your 'Mibo.'

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I've gotta hand it to you, though. Mibo's a really great design. Mind if I touch it?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Sure thing, have at it.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Aha, so cute.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: You were working on your designs too just now, right?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Yep, I got a couple new ideas. I'm gonna try them out as soon as we're back at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hehe, see, Control's like this too.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: She can see very far ahead of her. Sometimes, I get the feeling that not even the sky above can keep her from seeing beyond it.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: There probably isn't a single person in the world who knows just where it is she set her sights. Even I only have a vague idea of what's going on in her mind.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Eh, I've only ever caught a glimpse of her when she's giving speeches. Never knew she'd be like that too.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's right. There are lots of things that she just doesn't care about. To her, as long as her research isn't being blocked, that line might as well not exist.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That drove a wedge between her and Saria.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: But why are you telling me all this? Shouldn't you be talking to Silence?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: I'm not sure what I'd do with this information.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I'm telling you this because you don't know.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I figured that you two probably could've gotten along, so I wanted you to get a better idea of the kind of person she is.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Besides, I actually want to be friends with you myself. I like researchers like you, so pure.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: If I'm not mistaken, you voluntarily signed up for Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Yeah, I wanted a change of atmosphere.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Mind telling me why?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hm... I guess there wasn't really much of a reason.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Alright. If you ever come back to Rhine Lab, though, you should think about transferring to our department.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hm, I'll give it some thought.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Don't worry. We've got time.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Alright, why don't we get back to that story?
You... sure about this?
Yeah, I want to... try.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Mm...
Well, hello there.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Where am I...?
This here's my room, and it's also the prison clinic.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: I know who you are...
I know who you are too... The name's Domma.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: What am I doing here...?

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Right, there was a fight, and I got dragged into the mess...

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You passed out, Ms. Robin.

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: Anthony...?!

steps.name: Robin
steps.text: How come you know my name?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Domma has a list of prisoners here.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You're a hitman too, aren't you?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Domma found this weapon on you, and you were there. I could only arrive at this conclusion.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Of course, if you really aren't, you are free to prove me wrong.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Regardless of whether that is truly the case, I hope you could at least listen to what I have to say. Everything I'll be telling you is under the assumption that you came here to kill me. I mean no offense, and I hope you don't get the wrong impression.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I know who sent you here. They are the ones who orchestrated my family's downfall. They are also behind my imprisonment here for the past six years.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: And I've made my decision to break out of this prison to get to the end of it.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I can tell your combat prowess is superb, and I'm hoping you'd be willing to abandon your contract as a hitman and come help me.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: It's as simple as that.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You don't need to give me an answer right away.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I need a lot of time to prepare. You have a lot of time on your hands as well.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: If you want to kill me, you are free to keep trying. You could also give up.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: If you are interested in helping me, just pay the clinic a visit and let Domma know.

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Mr. Anthony, Captain Barton was wondering if you are doing okay. Are you hurt?

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: Nothing serious; just a few scrapes. Let him know to wait a little longer. I'll be finished here soon.

steps.name: Jailer
steps.text: Right, not a problem. Take your time.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: I need to deal with Barton.

steps.name: Anthony
steps.text: You should head back and think this offer through, Ms. Robin.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Heh, I thought Anthony was just some simple, kind-hearted guy, but it sounds like I'm not giving him enough credit.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hm? What makes you say that?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: We know for sure that Robin was there to kill him, but he didn't have any concrete proof. Yet he still made her that offer.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Really? I thought that was pretty reckless of him.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: If Robin wasn't there to kill him, and she tipped him off to the jailers, what happens then?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hehe, that's the part that I like about him.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Think about it. You're a fresh fish. No one knows who you are. Meanwhile, Anthony's built a reputation, a prestige for himself over the years.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Whose words do you think carry more weight?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Let's take a step back. Say Barton and the guards there really believed her. Could they have done anything about that?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: They couldn't have acted on that information.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Well, now that you mention it, I guess there wasn't much they could've done even if she ratted him out.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hehe, you think it's reckless, and you'd be right under normal circumstances. It's a risky move if he didn't have his 'prestige,' or perhaps 'influence' is the better word to use here.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But what I think is really interesting is that—Those who know how to build prestige for themselves don't usually do something like that.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hmm, and why's that?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's because what he said was also a threat. He was telling her, 'You could tell him, but it's not going to do you any good.'

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: When you hear that, it doesn't really sound like something that someone who's really got prestige would say, right?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Heh, you're right. It does sound like a threat.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: That's what I mean. Besides, did Anthony ever say anything about what he did to appease Barton?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Hm? Oh... he said he volunteered to be put in solitary for half a month.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Everyone knew that he wasn't the one at fault, but he chose to be punished to get this thing behind them, huh...?

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: I can almost imagine that grin on Barton's face when Anthony told him he was willing to accept punishment.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: But he still held back.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Tsk tsk, such a hard guy to deal with.

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: I think he probably just figured Robin wouldn't rat him out.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: Hm... it's possible. I won't deny it.

steps.name: Muelsyse
steps.text: By the way, Ms. Silence is really taking her time, isn't she?

steps.name: Mayer
steps.text: Yeah, you're right. I'll go take a look.
